name: add_feature_flag_percentage_rollout
description: Add a percentage-rollout flag type to a boolean/allowlist feature-flag evaluator, keyed so independent flags don't share the same enabled-user set
prompts: flags.py's is_enabled(flag, user_id, context=None) currently handles 'boolean' and 'allowlist' flag types. Add a 'percentage' type: {'type': 'percentage', 'name': ..., 'rollout': 0-100} enables the flag for roughly `rollout` percent of users. The assignment must be: deterministic (the same flag and user always get the same answer), roughly uniform across users, and - this is the part that's easy to get wrong - keyed on BOTH the flag's name and the user_id, so that two different percentage flags at the same rollout do not enable the identical set of users (hash the combination of flag name and user_id, not either alone). rollout=0 must enable nobody and rollout=100 must enable everybody. Unknown flag types still raise ValueError.
